Unlike route_yami_no_ou.json's shortest path (which kept starting BLOOD at 0), the only documented Ooka Report path to 究明編 requires two BLOOD bonuses along the way (see next two steps) — there is no 0-bonus route to this branch per geoooka.htm.

Total starting BLOOD level entering 究明編 via this path is 30 (10+20 from the two bonuses above) — higher than route_yami_no_ou.json's 0-BLOOD start, since no 0-bonus path to 究明編 exists in mmitsuru's geoooka.htm flowchart.

This is the most reliable point of agreement between the two sources for this route's deepest ending: both xneo.jp's Ending 26 (headed ～究明編～) and mmitsuru's geend26.htm page (explicitly titled 'End 26「究明編」') end with this exact B.S.S. trigger and outcome.

Route complete. This is the deepest and final documented conclusion of 究明編, reached by both xneo.jp (as its own Ending 26) and mmitsuru (as its explicitly-labelled 'End 26「究明編」'), despite the two sources disagreeing on several earlier choice details throughout this guide (see notes above: round2 wording, the 3-choice flavour set, tape colour, and several direction choices in the underground base). This guide does not continue into another route from here; the other five documented 究明編 endings (2, 3, 4, 11, 14) were covered earlier via save/load detours.
